simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָמַר (H559) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5318 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָמַר (ʼâmar) means to say (used with great latitude) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 9.

definitions.usage: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, × desire, determine, × expressly, × indeed, × intend, name, × plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), × still, × suppose, talk, tell, term, × that is, × think, use (speech), utter, × verily, × yet.
definitions.full: H559. amar אָמַר 5287 verb utter, say (MI, Phoenician אמר , Aramaic אֲמַר , Ethiopic I. 2 shew, declare , Arabic command ; perhaps √ אמר originally = be or make prominent , hence Hithpa`el below, אָמִיר ; Sabean אמר lofty , epithet of king JHMordtm ZMG 1876, 37 ; compare Dl Pr 28 who thinks original meaning hell, sichtbar sein , whence Assyrian amâru , see , & shew, declare, say ) — Qal Perfect ׳א Gen 3:1 +, etc.; Imperfect יאֹמַר 31:8 +; וַיּאֹ֫מֶר 1:3 +; וַיּאֹמַ֑ר 14:19 +; in Job always וַיּאֹ֑מַר Job 3:2 +; 3 feminine singular תּאֹמַר Gen 21:12 +; תּאֹמֵר֑ Prov 1:21 ; 1 singular אֹמַר Gen 22:2 +; אוֺמְרָה Psa 42:10 ; וָאֹמַר Gen 20:13 +; וָאוֺמַר Neh 2:7 , 17 , 20 ; 3 masculine plural יאֹמְדוּ Exod 4:1 + etc.; suffix יֹמְרוּךָ Psa 139:20 ; 2 masculine plural תֹּמְדוּ 2Sam 19:14 ( compare Kö i. p. 385 ); Imperative אֱמֹר (אֱמָרֿ) Gen 45:17 +, etc.; Infinitive absolute אָמוֺר Exod 21:5 +; construct אֱמֹר Ezek 25:8 +; (הַ)אֲמֹר Job 34:18 but read ᵑ9 ᵐ5 הָאֹמֵר Di, or better הֶאָמֹר Infinitive absolute with ה interrogative compare Ew :§ 328 d; suffix אָמְרִי Josh 6:10 +; אֲמָרְכֶם Jer 23:38 ; אֱמָרְכֶם Mal 1:7 +; לֵאמֹר Gen 1:22 +, etc.; Participle active אֹמֵר 32:10 +, etc.; passive הֶאָמוּר Micah 2:7 , but this grammatically indefensible, read הֶאָמוֺר , Infinitive absolute with ה interrogative, see Dr Expositor, April, 1887, 263 .1 Say (subject God Gen 3:1 +? 32:5 , serpent 3:1 , ass Num 22:28 , horse הֶאָח יאֹמַר Job 39:25 etc.; inanimate things, personified 28:14 compare 28:22 etc.; so in allegory or fable Judg 9:8 ; 2Kin 14:9 etc.; especially in narration, וַיּאֹמֶר etc., Gen 4:6 + very often): mostly followed by thing said, either substantive Jer 14:17 (c. clause app.) Deut 27:16 f.; Judg 12:6 ; pronoun Gen 44:16 ; 2Kin 20:14 +; or (usually) clause Gen 1:3 ; 3:1 ; 37:20 + often ( oratio recta [direct speech]); with adverb thus, so 32:5 ; Num 20:14 ; 1Kin 20:3 , 5 + often; especially י אָמַר ׳כֹּה Exod 5:1 ; 7:17 ; 8:1 ; 8:20 ; 1Chr 17:4 + often; the person addressed usually introduced by אֶל Gen 3:1 ; 15:7 ; 22:7 ; Lev 21:1 ; 2Sam 3:7 ; 1Kin 12:5 , 23 , or לְ Gen 3:13 ; 4:15 ; 1Sam 20:2 ; 2Sam 2:21 ; 1Kin 14:2 + often; rarer combinations are, ׳א בְּאָזְנֵי Isa 49:20 (compare 5:9 & see דבר ); ׳א לִפְנֵי Ezek 28:9 ; ׳א לְעֵינֵי Deut 31:7 ; Josh 10:12 ; Jer 28:11 ; ׳א בְּ Joel 2:17 ; Psa 126:2 , where בְּ local; in all cases usually followed by direct object of words said, Exod 19:25 being very singular; Gen 4:8 the object-clause has probably fallen out, compare Vrss Di; = mention, name, designate 22:2-3 , 43:27 , 29 ; Exod 32:13 ; Num 14:40 ; 1Sam 10:16 ; 16:3 ; 2Sam 6:22 ; Neh 6:19 ; compare Psa 139:20 לִמְזִמָּה יֹמְרוּךָ speak of thee for falsehood (but many, as Hup Pe Dy Che, read יַמְרוּךָ ); = tell, declare, proclaim , (followed by direct object only) 40:11 ; Ezek 13:7 ; in reply to question = answer Exod 12:27 ; Josh 4:7 ; 1Kin 9:9 ; Jer 5:19 ; 22:9 . The object spoken of may be referred to by אֶל 2Kin 19:32 ; Jer 22:18 ; 27:19 , or לְ Gen 20:13 לִֹי אִמְרִי say of me, etc. Deut 33:9 ; Judg 9:54 ; Isa 5:20 ; Psa 3:3 ; 71:10 , very rarely by a simple accusative Isa 3:10 (where read probably for אַשְׁרֵי אִמְרוּ, ), except after אֲשֶׁר where the words used follow (compare אֲשֶׁר 4d ) Gen 3:17 ; Num 10:29 ; 14:31 ; Deut 28:68 ; Judg 7:4 ; 1Sam 9:17 , 23 b 1Kin 8:29 ; Lam 4:20 ; compare Num 21:16 ; 2Kin 17:12 ; 21:4 , & (two extreme cases) Isa 8:12 ; Lam 2:15 (see Dr Sm i. 24, 5 ); ֶהאָמוּר Micah 2:7 read infinitive absolute with ה interrogative הֶאָמוֺר (see above) shall one say ? shall it be said ? After another verb of saying, introducing thing said: Deut 21:7 ; 25:9 ; 27:15 ; Song 2:10 +, even after אמר Gen 22:7 ; Lev 21:1 ; Jer 34:2 ; Est 7:5 +; especially infinitive לֵאמֹר , after דבר Gen 8:15 , צוה 2:16 , ענה 44:16 , ברך 1:22 , נשׁבע 24:7 , נדר 28:20 , etc.; after אמר 2Sam 3:18 ; 1Kin 12:23 ; Ruth 4:4 ; 1Chr 21:18 +; after שׁלח 2Chr 35:21 , שׁוּב Gen 32:7 ; compare also 28:6 ; Exod 5:13 ; 9:5 ; 13:8 ; 17:4 ; Num 11:20 ; Deut 1:28 ; 13:7 ; Judg 8:15 ; 1Sam 23:2 ; 1Kin 13:3 ; Jer 32:3 ; 37:9 +; also when subject of לֵאמֹר differs from that of pre-ceding clause Gen 31:1 ; 38:13 , 24 etc.; after שׁמע Isa 37:9 = 2Kin 19:9 . 2 Say in the heart (= think) ׳א בלבב Deut 8:17 compare 1Kin 12:26 ; Psa 10:6 ; 10:11 ; 10:13 ; 14:1 ; 35:25 ; Isa 14:13 ; 47:8 , 10 ; 49:21 ; Eccl 2:1 , 15 ; 3:17-18 , ׳א לִלְבָבָם Hosea 7:2 ; ׳א אֶללִֿבּוֺ Gen 8:21 said unto his heart (to himself), subject ׳י , compare 1Sam 27:1 ; נַפֲשִׁי אָֽמְרָה Lam 3:24 ; thence ׳א alone Gen 20:11 ; 26:9 ; Num 24:11 ; Ruth 4:4 ; 1Sam 20:26 ; 2Sam 5:6 ; 12:22 ; 2Kin 5:11 ; followed by clause with כִּי Judg 15:2 ; in particular = desire נַפְשְׁךָ מַהתּֿאֹמַר 1Sam 20:4 compare Est 2:13 ; followed by infinitive = purpose , Exod 2:14 thinkest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian ? Josh 22:33 ; 1Sam 30:6 ; 1 Kings 5:19; 2Chr 28:10 , 13 ; expect 2Sam 21:16 he expected to slay David 2Chr 13:8 ; 32:1 . 3 Promise (followed by infinitive) 1Chr 27:23 ; 2Chr 21:7 ; Est 4:7 ; ( id. + ל of person) 2Kin 8:19 ; Neh 9:15 ; (followed by accusative of direct object + ל of person + infinitive of purpose) 9:23 . 4 Command (especially late) followed by אֶלֿ of per-son addressed, Num 15:38 ; 1Chr 21:18 ; followed by ל Josh 11:9 ; 2Sam 16:11 ; 2Kin 4:24 ; Job 9:7 ; Psa 106:34 (see below אֲשֶׁר 8e ); followed by infinitive 1Sam 24:11 ; 1Chr 21:17 ; 2Chron 1:18; 2Chr 29:27 , 30 ; 31:11 ; 35:21 ; Est 1:17 ; 4:13 , 15 ; 6:1 ; 9:14 ; followed by infinitive + ל of pers, 2Chr 14:3 ; 29:21 ; 31:4 ; Est 1:10 ; followed by accusative direct object 2Chr 29:24 the king commanded the burnt-offering and the sin-offering , compare 1 Kings 5:20; Est 2:15 ; followed by clause with אשׁר = that Neh 13:19 ; id. + ל of person 13:22 ; followed by clause with כִּי Job 36:10 ; absolute 1Sam 16:16 (read however probably יאמרו for יאמר , compare Dr); also Psa 105:31 ; 105:34 ; 107:25 ; 1Chr 14:12 ; 2Chr 24:8 ; Neh 13:9 , 19 (all followed by verb consecutive); command by letter ׳א עִםהַֿסֵּפֶר Est 9:25 (followed by imperfect); appoint, assign א ׳לֶחֶם לוֺ 1Kin 11:18 = threaten followed by infinitive Deut 9:25 ; Psa 106:23 . Niph`al Perfect נֶאֱמַר Dan 8:26 ; Imperfect יֵאָמֵר Gen 22:14 +; לוֺ יֵאָ֫מֶר Isa 4:3 ; יֵאָמַ֑ר Gen 10:9 +; וַיֵּאָמַ֑ר Josh 2:2 ; be said, told Gen 10:9 ; 22:14 ; Psa 87:5 ; Jer 4:11 ; 16:14 (all absolute, indefinite subject, of current saying); so said in a book Num 21:14 ; be related, told , of vision Dan 8:26 ; said, told to (followed by ל indirect object) Josh 2:2 ; Hosea 2:1 (twice in verse); Zeph 3:16 ; either so, or told concerning Num 23:23 ; Ezek 13:12 ( אֶלֿ ); לָכֶם יֵאָמֵר = ye shall be called (it shall be said to you) Isa 61:6 (|| תִּקָּרְאוּ ), compare 4:3 ; 19:18 ; 32:5 (|| ל יִקָּרֵא ) 62:4 (twice in verse); hence be called , of Tophet הַתֹּפֶת עוֺד לֹאיֵֿאָמֵר Jer 7:32 ; subject שֵׁם Gen 32:29 ; Job 34:31 הֶאָמַר אֶלאֵֿל כִּי , Rabb (compare AV) treat הֵאָמַר as Niph`al Infinitive for לְהֵאָמֵר , but against grammar; the form as it stands is Qal Perfect, אֶלאֵֿל being prefixed to the interrogative for emphasis (compare Jer 22:15 ; 23:26 ; Neh 13:27 ), see Dr § 9 Di and others; Hoffm., however, reads הֵאָמֵר infinitive absolute = imperative 'so must one speak (it be spoken) to God.' Hiph`il Perfect avow, avouch Deut 26:17 ׳אֶתיֿ לֵאלֹהִים לְךָ לִהְיוֺת הַיּוֺם הֶאֱמַרְתָּ ; 26:18 לְעַם לוֺ להיות היום הֶאֱמִירְךָ ׳וי (literally cause to declare , i.e. through agency of Moses; on this & other interpretations see Di).
